title: Understanding Cross-Validation
text: In 4-fold cross-validation, the dataset is divided into $$4$$ equal parts. Each part is used as a validation set once, while the remaining parts are used for training. Can you visualize how this rotation ensures each data point is validated exactly once?

title: Exploring the Validation Set
text: Consider how many times each data point appears in the validation set during 4-fold cross-validation. Is it possible for a data point to be in the validation set more than once?

title: Rotation of Folds
text: Think about the rotation of the folds in cross-validation. Each fold takes a turn being the validation set. How does this rotation affect the inclusion of data points in the validation set?
